01

Strength
you can control.

Omni is not a room full of machines. It is a functional strength facility built around how bodies actually move.

Omni Gym has been Peebles’ strength gym since 2013 — a functional strength facility at Cavalry Park with a wide range of equipment for every level, from first-timers to seasoned lifters.

The coaching here starts from a simple idea: real strength is not how much you can lift, it is how well you can control your body under load. Slow, precise, well-coached work builds the stabilisers, the balance and the confidence that heavy, sloppy lifting never will.

And unlike the leisure centre down the road, the door is open when you need it. Your key fob gets you in from 6am to midnight, 365 days a year — before work, between jobs, or after the kids are in bed.

ControlTechnique first, load second.

04 · From the floor

OMNIROX.
Engine work.

Omni’s own high-intensity circuit: kettlebells, sandbags, SkiErg, rower, bike, running and slam balls — built to develop strength, power, endurance and cardiovascular fitness at the same time.

It burns calories fast, improves functional movement, boosts athletic performance and keeps every session different. Varied, challenging, total-body training — the hard way, the fun way.
